title: Certificate - ICAO Visible Digital Seal Logical Model
description: Data elements for the ICAO Visible Digital Seal Core Data Set. Based on <https://www.icao.int/vdsnc-spec> as of 2023-02-02.

resourceType.description: Resource type identifier for CertICAO logical model

@context.description: JSON-LD context for this logical model with ValueSet vocabularies

anyOf.description: URI reference to external JSON-LD context

@type.description: JSON-LD type identifier for CertICAO logical model

id.description: Unique id for the element within a resource (for internal references). This may be any string value that does not contain spaces.

modifierExtension.description:
May be used to represent additional information that is not part of the basic definition of the element and that modifies the understanding of the element in which it is contained and/or the understanding of the containing element's descendants. Usually modifier elements provide negation or qualification. To make the use of extensions safe and manageable, there is a strict set of governance applied to the definition and use of extensions. Though any implementer can define an extension, there is a set of requirements that SHALL be met as part of the definition of the extension. Applications processing a resource are required to check for modifier extensions.

Modifier extensions SHALL NOT change the meaning of any elements on Resource or DomainResource (including cannot change the meaning of modifierExtension itself).

t.description: Type (either `icao.test` for proof of testing, or `icao.vacc` for proof of vaccination)

is.description: The three letter code is according to Doc 9303-3, which defines this as ISO-3166 country codes.

n.description: Name (Name of the holder (as specified in Doc 9303-3) MUST be used.)

dob.description: Date of Birth (The DOB of the test subject. The [RFC 3339] full date format YYYY-MM- DD MUST be used.)

dt.description:
The ID Document Type of the identity document MUST be used. Only these values MUST be used:

- `P` – Passport (Doc 9303-4)
- `A` – ID Card (Doc 9303-5)
- `C` – ID Card (Doc 9303-5)
- `I` – ID Card Doc 9303-5)
- `AC` - Crew Member Certificate (Doc 9303-5)
- `V` – Visa (Doc 9303-7)
- `D` – Driving License (ISO 18013-1)

dn.description: ID Document Number of the identity document

sex.description: Sex of the test subject (as specified in Doc 9303-4 Section 4.1.1.1 – Visual Inspection Zone)

utci.description: UTCI (Unique Test Certificate Identifier; used for `icao.test` only, not used of `icao.vacc`)

sp.description: ServiceProvider (Required for `icao.test` only, not used of `icao.vacc`)

spn.description: Name of testing facility or service provider

ctr.description: The country in which the individual has been vaccinated. A three letter code identifying the issuing state or organization. The three letter code is according to Doc 9303-3, which defines this as ISO-3166 country codes.

dat.description: DateTimeTestReport (Required for `icao.test` only, not used of `icao.vacc`)

tr.description: TestResult (Required for `icao.test` only, not used of `icao.vacc`)

opt.description: Optional data issued at the discretion of the issuing authority

uvci.description: Unique Vaccination Certificate Identifier (Required for `icao.vacc` only, not used of `icao.test`)

ve.description: VaccinationEvent (Required for `icao.vacc` only, not used of `icao.test`)

des.description: Vaccine or Prophylaxis (ICD-11 MMS code descending from http://id.who.int/icd/entity/164949870)

dvc.description: Date on which the vaccine was administered. The ISO8601 full date format YYYY-MM-DD MUST be used.

seq.description: Dose number (vaccine dose number, integer between 1 and 99)

adm.description: Administering centre (The name or identifier of the vaccination facility)

dvn.description: Date on which the next 10 vaccination should be administered. The ISO8601 full date format YYYY-MM-DD MUST be used.

sigvl.description: SignatureValue (Signature value signed over the Data in base64url [RFC 4648])
